title: Plugin Management
content:
## Register Python Plug-In

Marvelous Designer now supports registering **Python (.py)** plug-ins directly.

Registered plug-ins will appear in the **Plugin** tab and can be launched directly from within Marvelous Designer.

**Supported formats by OS:**

  * **Windows:** **.py**

  * **macOS:** **.py**




**To register a plug-in:**

  1. Open **Plugin** tab → **Plug-in Manager**.

  2. Click the **\+ ADD** button.

  3. Select your plug-in file (`.py`) and click **Open**.

  4. Name the plug-in and choose its display position in the **Plugin** tab.

  5. Click **OK**.




Your plug-in is now successfully added and will appear in the designated position in the **Plugin** tab.

**Note:**
